Owner decisions 2026-10-12: a restore puts the user's staging of the files it writes back as it was at the snapshot; when HEAD has moved since the snapshot (the agent or the user committed), it falls back to unstaging restored files whose staged version differs from the restored file, so no revert of a commit is left staged.
